reasoning: Both attempts made exactly the same change to default.project.json (both diffs end at blob 4d0f5dc). Each fixes the mapping correctly but leaves the UTF-8 byte order mark in place, so neither project parses: both fail rojo build and rojo sourcemap. The only real difference is the guide. B's guide covers everything the rubric asks for: Studio edits to properties, attributes and new instances get overwritten; Save to File for work built in Studio; servePlaceIds; the Rojo 7.7.x crash after deletes, moves or renames, and reconnecting; and saving without a BOM plus running sourcemap before pushing. A's guide leaves out servePlaceIds, the crash and reconnect advice, and Save to File or syncback. B wins.
